RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about your denied claim. I've reviewed your case and confirmed that the denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". I understand that your doctor ordered the MRI for your migraines, and I'm here to help you with the next steps.

You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. Since the denial notice was sent to you on September 2, 2026, your appeal deadline is March 1, 2027. 

To initiate the appeal process, please find attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) for your reference. Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. If you need any assistance with the appeal process or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to me directly.

Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days. I'll be happy to guide you through this process and ensure that your appeal is processed efficiently.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to contact me. Your health and well-being are our top priority, and I'm committed to supporting you throughout this process.

Best regards,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
